name: Guilin University of Electronic Technology
aliases: Guilin University of Electronic Science and Technology
supervisors: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Government (co-built with MIIT and with SASTIND)

evidence.summary: GUET describes itself as co-built by the Guangxi regional government with the industry ministry (MIIT) and, separately, with the defence-industry regulator SASTIND.

Founded in 1960, it was run in turn by the Fourth Ministry of Machine-Building and China’s electronics industry ministries before passing in 2000 to joint central and regional oversight under mainly Guangxi management.
